summary: Stores CHOP channels from the current cook for use on a later frame or time slice, allowing stable CHOP feedback loops without infinite recursion.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Previous channels, shifted channels, or last sample output mode

key_params.name: delta
key_params.note: Adds a dt channel with elapsed time between cooks

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Disable feedback and pass through input while reset is on

key_concepts: Stores CHOP channels from the current frame for use in a later frame or time slice.
Supports recursive control chains that need the previous output of a CHOP chain as the current input.
Breaks circular CHOP loops without infinite recursion by copying input state without forcing an upstream recook.
Output mode selects previous channels at previous time, previous channels at current time, or only the last sample at current time.
Delta Time adds a dt channel with elapsed time since the last cook.
Reset set to 0 activates feedback; reset set to 1 disables feedback and passes input through.
common_gotchas: Reset must be off for feedback to accumulate previous-frame state.
Feedback CHOP copies input without forcing upstream recook, so verify loop timing with Info CHOP or channel inspection.
Use explicit damping or limiting downstream when feeding values back into motion or simulation controls.
